meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: Claude 会扫描代码仓库,按 9 个维度(架构、一致性、类型、测试、依赖、性能、错误处理、安全、文档)查技术债,每条发现标注 file:line,并写出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,内含严重级、工时估算、Top 5 优先级和快速修复清单。
howto.when: 当你说出 “tech debt”、“code health”、“debt audit” 等关键词,或要求做代码健康检查、架构审查、代码质量评估、清理规划时触发。

say.text: 审计这个仓库的技术债,输出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 生成含严重级和工时估算的审计报告

say.text: 只查安全维度,重点看硬编码密钥和空 catch 块
say.note: 跳过其他维度,只跑指定搜索

say.text: 这个仓库代码健康度如何?列出前 5 个优先修复项
say.note: 按影响/工时比排序给出清单

howto.what_en: Claude scans your repo for tech debt across 9 dimensions (architecture, consistency, types, tests, deps, performance, error handling, security, docs), cites file:line for every finding, and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, hour estimates, Top 5 priorities and quick wins.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "tech debt", "code health", "debt audit" or similar, or ask for a codebase health check, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning.

say_en.text: Audit this repo for tech debt and write TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Produces the report with severity and effort estimates

say_en.text: Only check the security dimension: hardcoded secrets and empty catch blocks
say_en.note: Skips other dimensions, runs only those searches

say_en.text: How healthy is this codebase? List the top 5 priorities
